prompt:
The same man as in the reference image - a male clerk in his mid-forties, short
dark hair, light stubble, dark navy sweater - seen from the waist up behind a
municipal information counter, vertical framing, photographed from the
customer's side. He is three quarters to camera, turned slightly to his left,
looking at someone off screen to the LEFT of frame, never at the camera. His
expression is neutral and unhurried: a man doing his job, neither friendly nor
cold. The worn wooden counter crosses the lower part of the frame, with a date
stamp and a pen on a chain on it. Behind him, the pale mint-green wall with its
darker green dado rail, a window with a yellow-painted frame out of focus.
Mixed daylight and fluorescent light. Documentary realism.

Use the reference images for the man - his face, his age, his build, his
sweater - and for the counter and the wall, and NOT for the framing.
